basis: Delirium is an acute disorder of brain function, explicitly included in the neurologic axis.
Lysosomal neurodegeneration; neurogenic bladder causes urinary dysfunction in 2/3. Respiratory insufficiency and cortical visual loss do not establish intrinsic lung or eye injury.
Isolated TTN-related dilated cardiomyopathy; skeletal myopathy is not established for this concept.
Fractures, hearing loss, cholestasis and secretory enteropathy each occur in 4/4; villous atrophy in 2/4. Developmental delay in 2/4 omitted at the four-axis cap.
Defined by deficient immunity; no particular additional organ is directly damaged across most immunodeficiency disorders.
Carcinoma arising in the penis, a reproductive organ outside the axes; squamous histology does not establish a cutaneous origin.
Permanent congenital finger-joint flexion contracture; explicitly non-neurogenic.
DEGS1-related sphingolipid metabolic disease causing hypomyelinating leukodystrophy. Nystagmus and feeding difficulty do not establish separate eye or gut injury.
Malignant neoplasm originating in the descending colon.
B-cell lymphoma involving splenic red pulp, marrow and circulating blood; lymphoma also requires the infectious_immune axis.
Neuronal migration disorder with heterotopia and developmental impairment. Ear and gingival anomalies reported in one patient do not establish prevalence across the larger cohort.
Absent hormone-producing testes with low testosterone in 80-99%; supplied annotations report urethral fistula and urogenital sinus malformations in 30-79%.
Hereditary hypomelanotic pigmentation disorder; no evidence of additional organ damage.
Mitochondrial metabolic disorder defined by hepatic and cerebral disease. Renal involvement belongs to a narrower subtype and is not established across this umbrella.
Tumor arises in the prostate, a reproductive gland outside the axes; its urinary-system ancestor does not establish urinary-organ involvement.
Immunodeficiency and pancytopenia in 4/4; developmental/learning impairment in 3/4 and hemivertebrae in 2/2. Dermatitis in 2/4 omitted at cap; recurrent infections are separate diseases.
Primary autonomic nervous system dysfunction; altered blood pressure and heart rate do not alone establish intrinsic cardiovascular damage.
Benign tumor of the uterine body, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Hereditary cutaneous/subcutaneous angioedema. Episodic bowel and laryngeal edema lack evidence of lasting damage; hereditary angioedema does not itself establish an immune mechanism.
Cutaneous disorder supported by the skin phenotype annotation; no evidence of other organ involvement.
Benign neoplasm arising in the epicardium, part of the heart and pericardial system.
Defining spinal dysraphism and vertebral defect with hypospadias, a urethral malformation; additional anomalies are not established as common.
Autoinflammatory arthritis; pleuritis in 30-79% supports pulmonary involvement. Rash is transient; hepatitis occurs in 5-29%, and reactive blood changes do not establish blood-organ injury.
HSF4-related nonsyndromic cataract directly affects the lens.
Autoimmune inflammation of the liver; liver-pancreas antigen antibodies do not establish pancreatic damage.
